candidate_query_decompositions.name: host_mounted_volume_pool_inventory
candidate_query_decompositions.candidate_SQL:
SELECT i.id AS instance_id, n.id AS node_id, vm.id AS host_vm_id,
       r.volumeId AS volume_id, r.mountDevice AS mount_device,
       v.bootable AS bootable, v.size AS volume_size,
       p.id AS storage_pool_id, p.poolName AS storage_pool_name
FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE i
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE n ON n.ref_instanceId = i.id
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA vm ON vm.id = n.ref_vmbmsId
LEFT JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM r ON r.vmId = vm.id
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME v ON v.id = r.volumeId
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL p ON p.id = v.attachBackendId
candidate_query_decompositions.coverage: Static exact joins cover12/14 instances and24/30 nodes; LEFT JOIN should preserve unresolved rows rather than infer a pool.
candidate_query_decompositions.multiplicity: Output at instance/node/volume/pool grain; relation is declared many-to-many. Use canonical id and explicit distinct grain when grouping, not GROUP BY vdc with a stray instance name.
candidate_query_decompositions.startup_filter: Only apply bootable true/false when that exact startup/non-startup distinction is requested; do not translate false to database-purpose.
candidate_query_decompositions.deployment_blocker: The unchanged executor drops missing previous-step conditions and may fall back to all rows. Without a dependency-empty guard and explicit unsupported-scope handling, do not promote this candidate as a general safe template.
